book.title: 白天为什么看不见星星
book.subtitle: 明亮天空里的星光
book.question: 白天为什么看不见星星？

moral.zh: 白天星星仍在天空中，只是阳光被大气散射，让天空太亮，微弱的星光难以分辨。
moral.en: Stars remain in the daytime sky, but scattered sunlight makes the sky too bright for their faint light to stand out.

pages.zhText: 清晨，窗外的星星一颗颗淡去了。琳琳问：“它们去哪儿了？”
pages.enText: At dawn, the stars faded one by one outside the window. “Where did they go?” Linlin asked.

pages.zhText: 太阳升高，天空变亮。琳琳睁大眼睛，却找不到一颗星。
pages.enText: As the Sun rose higher, the sky grew bright. Linlin looked carefully, but could not find a single star.

pages.zhText: 许多散开的阳光照亮天空。星光太微弱，眼睛就分辨不出来了。
pages.enText: All that scattered sunlight brightens the whole sky. Compared with it, faint starlight is too weak for our eyes to pick out.
